newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa ups Sweden, Poland flights.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa ups Sweden, Poland flights.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG will add three new Swedish destinations in co-operation with code-share partner Scandinavian Airlines System from October 27.
SAS will fly daily under a joint code from Duesseldorf, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Munich and Stuttgart via Stockholm to Kiruna, Lulea and Sundsvall, a Lufthansa statement said.
Lufthansa will start a five times a week non-stop service from Duesseldorf to Katowice in Poland.
A third daily flight between Frankfurt and Warsaw will be offered pending official traffic rights, the statement said.
Lufthansa will build up its second Germany hub in Munich with flights three times a day to Zurich, four times a week to Valencia and three times a week to Cairo.
It will switch Palma de Mallorca flights from Frankfurt to Munich and add a seventh weekly service, the statement said.
New Team Lufthansa franchise partner Augsburg Airways will fly daily from Munich to Dortmund, Leipzig and Erfurt, it added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
